method: Unchanged original Elf/PlayerSystem/LodSystem/ParachuteSystem/EntityRemovalSystem/ClientSystem and actual bundled THREE in CPU-only Node VM. No browser/window/GPU/input. Original GLTFLoader runs but its FileLoader I/O is held pending (no callbacks): requested flag/root/ring state, NOT loaded-model pixels, actions or material opacity. Texture Canvas/Image I/O, collisions, input subscriptions, events/network are inert. Explicit map/camera/time/health/LOD/erosion and post-Player teleport inputs; LOD rectangle is allocated at supplied dimensions each step. Actual core system order: LOD, Removal, Parachute, Client, Player. No LocalLevel spawning/erosion/AI or collision step. Seeded LCG supplies distinct source UUIDs; no RNG matching is claimed. Pools empty per case, global model promise and module marker retain source behavior. Separate ring-only sequence tests source setup/update/teardown/reassignment; complete native assignment/pooled scene restart remains unfinished.
native_verification: Production finish_frame compares post-Player and post-command snapshots: 8 cases / 46 frames / 92 state comparisons. Source afterLod snapshots are retained, not directly hooked in the native comparator. A separate 13-operation ClientRing comparison checks ownership/visibility/setup/teardown/reassignment semantics, not complete native controller reassignment. sceneVisible is hierarchy eligibility only (visible flags plus current root membership), not frustum/screen pixels. Native collisions are reset empty and LocalLevel is not run; source core pipeline and I/O stubs are explicit.
remaining: Actual asynchronous model completion/clone/pooled reuse and loaded-material opacity/action timing are not implemented by this state flag. Native view still uses eager shared model loading. Full generic LOD registration mutation/duplicates, scene restart and raw old-dolly marker ownership are not certified. Native leave_scene forgets ownership outside the current actor set while retaining mesh visibility. Legacy frozen raster import explicitly bypasses readiness/root LOD and restores its known living/arrived local ring; that diagnostic was not executed.
